## ⚙️ Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/GAUTAMSANSWAL/python-bootcamp.git
cd python-bootcamp
pip install -r requirements.txt
jupyter notebook
```

**Requirements**
```
numpy
pandas
matplotlib
seaborn
scikit-learn
flask
openai
jupyter
```
